turns.text: This fictional appointment concerns the lung biopsy report. Before we discuss its wording, have you noticed any change in your cough?
The dry cough is still present in the evening. I have no fever and no coughing up blood, but I feel tired.
The draft report contains an EGFR test entry marked pending. It does not yet document a final molecular result.
I thought pending meant negative. I also saw pembrolizumab in an older letter, but it is not on my current medicine list.
I will distinguish the older medicine mention from current use. Pending means the laboratory entry is awaiting a completed report.
Please write that I have not started that medicine. My breathlessness on stairs is unchanged, and I have no chest pain.
Those details are recorded as your report. The follow-up call on Friday is already booked to discuss the completed results and questions.
I will bring the older letter to that conversation. Please also note that the cough interrupts my sleep on some nights.
